meta.description: Registry for bounded nonlocal transport closure limit conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

transport_closure_limit_entries.name: Nonlocal Transport Closure Limits
transport_closure_limit_entries.purpose: Represent bounded closure-limit behavior across CSI-linked recursive nonlocal transport systems.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: nonlocal_transport_closure_limits_remain_defined
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Formal support for identifying boundaries where transport closure becomes incomplete or fragmented.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: CSI_metric_incompleteness_remains_detectable
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: The system must maintain metrics for registering gaps in interaction domain coverage.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: recursive_transport_fragmentation_remains_classifiable
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to categorize the loss of transport continuity under iteration.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: transport_updates_under_nonlocal_recursion_remain_admissible
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Fragmentation in transport must still satisfy current process admissibility windows.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_transport_decay_remains_bounded
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Directional decay rules must be sufficient to maintain finite flux across fragmented domains.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: finite_transport_flux_preserved_under_closure_limits
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Flux must not diverge even if the transport domain becomes non-closed.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_transport_fragmentation_witness
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Pruning of isolated transport nodes must not eliminate all possible nonlocal paths.

transport_closure_limit_conditions.name: transport_closure_instability_remains_detectable
transport_closure_limit_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register the breakdown of closure limit boundaries.
